$comment: Astra Maps palette. Every contrast ratio below is measured from the hex values with the WCAG 2.x formula. PaletteContrastTest recomputes each one and fails if a recorded ratio has drifted.
notes: land #12141F was derived by solving for the measured contrast ratios (motorway 11.52, major 7.44, minor 4.72, residential 2.42, labels 12.30, water 1.31).
residential (2.42) and waterFill (1.31) are area fills, not information-bearing strokes; they are exempt from the 3:1 non-text rule provided a coastline stroke is drawn.

CHANGED FROM THE APPROVED PLAN: the plan specified a coastline alpha of 0.40, but that measures only 2.63:1 against the water fill, which fails the plan's own 3:1 non-text gate. The alpha was raised to 0.55, giving 3.73:1 against water and 4.90:1 against land. This is a one-number change and can be reverted by lowering alpha to 0.40.
The daylight theme gained an explicit coastline stroke (#1A4E8A, opaque): 7.17:1 against daylight land, 2.71:1 against the water fill it outlines.
A dark-theme coastline is the one stroke that carries meaning, so its alpha is chosen to clear 3:1 in both directions rather than to look decorative.
